Landing.description_game: 《冥月悸動》是一款單人 Roguelite 卡牌遊戲。60秒內即可分出勝負的超短期決戰。一招一式皆可能招致死亡，讓玩家體驗如同「高難度遊戲」般的緊張感。其特色在於雙方手牌完全公開且同時出牌的遊戲系統。
Landing.guide_intro: This is the application form for the closed battle beta test, where you can get early access to the battles of “LUNAR PULSE” (<link>https://store.steampowered.com/app/2220860/</link>).
Landing.guide_intro_note: *The information you enter will be used only for running this test and as reference for development.
Landing.info_period_note: ※ 日期可能在未事先通知下調整。
Landing.guide_capacity_note1: *If there are more applicants than this, a lottery will be held.
Landing.guide_capacity_note2: *Only winners will be notified, by email by [ Monday, August 24, 2026, 23:59 ] (JST), together with details on how to participate.
Landing.info_notice_desc: Winners will receive an email from the address below.
Landing.guide_notice_note1: *The email may be sorted into your spam folder, so please check there as well.
Landing.guide_notice_note2: *To make sure you receive it, please add the address above to your contacts or allow emails from it.
Landing.info_req_steam: Steam 帳號（Steam Deck 不保證穩定）
Landing.info_req_google: Google account (the winner notification is sent to this account's email address)
Landing.info_req_discord: 必須加入官方 Discord 伺服器
Landing.info_stream_desc: 歡迎直播與分享，請註明此為開發中版本。
Landing.info_stream_desc2: When you do, please state that it is a work-in-progress build.
Landing.form_email_sub: Steam 測試序號及問卷將寄送至此信箱。
Landing.discord_hint_1: （請輸入使用者名稱，而非顯示名稱）
Landing.discord_hint_warn: ※ 若無法確認帳號，將取消資格。
Landing.form_consent_sub: 請勾選全部項目後報名：
Landing.consent_1: 我能自行準備所需的 Windows PC 環境。
Landing.consent_2: 我理解此為開發中版本，可能包含錯誤與未調整的內容。
Landing.consent_3: 我不會轉讓或公開取得的 Steam 測試序號。
Landing.consent_4: 我會在測試結束後填寫回饋問卷。
Landing.consent_5: 我年滿13歲（未滿18歲已取得監護人同意）。
Landing.form_privacy_legal: 個人資料僅用於本次測試運營，受 Fahrenheit213 隱私權政策約束。
Landing.modal_desc: 感謝您的報名。若入選，序號與說明將於測試開始前寄至您的信箱。
Landing.err_email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
Landing.err_discord_required: Please enter your Discord user name.
Landing.err_discord_invalid: Invalid Discord user name: use 6–32 letters, numbers, underscores or periods (no two periods in a row).
Landing.err_consent_required: Please check all agreements to apply.
Landing.err_submit_failed: Could not submit your application. Please try again later.
Landing.form_wishlist_label: Have you added Tsurugi Hime to your Steam wishlist?
Landing.confirm_desc: Please check your entries. Your application is sent when you press Submit.
Landing.apply_done_lead: Only winners will be notified. We’ll email winners by Monday, November 30, 2026, 23:59 (JST), along with details on how to participate.
Landing.apply_done_not_selected: Please note that applicants who are not selected will not be contacted.
